rsWallJoin.zh: 接长、连接墙段用 rsWallConnect；整理 T 形或十字交接用 rsWallJoint。
rsWallJoin.en: Use rsWallConnect to connect or extend wall segments; use rsWallJoint for T and cross junctions.

rsWall2DReconnect.zh: 二维墙体重连已归入统一的墙体重连命令。
rsWall2DReconnect.en: 2D wall reconnection now uses the unified wall reconnection command.

rsWall2DAutoJoin.zh: 二维墙体自动交接已归入统一的墙体自动交接命令。
rsWall2DAutoJoin.en: 2D automatic wall junctions now use the unified automatic junction command.

rsFilletWall2D.zh: 二维墙体圆角改用统一的墙体圆角命令。
rsFilletWall2D.en: Use the unified wall fillet command for 2D wall corners.

rsBreakWall2D.zh: 二维墙体打断改用统一的墙体打断命令。
rsBreakWall2D.en: Use the unified wall break command for 2D walls.

rsDoor2D.zh: 门的二维和三维绘制合并到同一个窗口，在面板中选择模式。
rsDoor2D.en: 2D and 3D doors share one window. Choose the output mode in the panel.

rsWindow2D.zh: 窗的二维和三维绘制合并到同一个窗口，在面板中选择模式。
rsWindow2D.en: 2D and 3D windows share one window. Choose the output mode in the panel.

rsElevator2D.zh: 电梯改用统一入口，在面板中选择二维或三维。
rsElevator2D.en: Use the unified elevator command and choose 2D or 3D in its panel.

rsStair2D.zh: 二维双跑楼梯已合并到双跑楼梯窗口，可切换二维和三维。
rsStair2D.en: 2D double-flight stairs are now part of the double-flight stair window, with 2D and 3D modes.

rsPolylineStair2D.zh: 自由二维楼梯已合并到多跑楼梯窗口，共用路径和尺寸设置。
rsPolylineStair2D.en: Free-form 2D stairs now use the multi-flight stair window, sharing its path and dimensions.

rsModelOld.zh: 旧模型库窗口入口不再保留，改用客户端模型库。
rsModelOld.en: The legacy model-library window is no longer exposed. Use the client model library.

InsertAssetOld.zh: 旧插入模型入口不再保留，在客户端模型库中选择素材并导入。
InsertAssetOld.en: Use the client model library to select and import an asset. The old insertion command is no longer exposed.

InsertAsset.zh: 插入与连续插入已放进客户端模型库，不再单独输入此命令。
InsertAsset.en: Import and repeated import are actions inside the client model library rather than a separate Rhino command.

rsMaterialLibraryOld.zh: 旧材质库入口不再保留，改用客户端材质库。
rsMaterialLibraryOld.en: The legacy material-library command is no longer exposed. Use the client material library.

rsEarthOld.zh: 地形下载改用客户端入口；rsTerrain 是地形生成，不是这个旧命令的替代名称。
rsEarthOld.en: Use the client terrain-download entry. rsTerrain generates terrain and is not a renamed download command.

rsVectorStudioSyncCanvas.zh: 改在客户端矢量工作室中使用同步到 Rhino 的操作，不再单独运行旧命令。
rsVectorStudioSyncCanvas.en: Use the sync-to-Rhino action inside the client vector studio instead of the old standalone command.

rsDeleteWall2D.zh: 选择墙体后使用 Rhino 的 Delete，关联交接会随删除更新。
rsDeleteWall2D.en: Select the wall and use Rhino Delete. Connected junctions update with the deletion.

rsMoveOpening2D.zh: 选择门窗后使用 Rhino 的平面 Move，位置变动由关联同步处理。
rsMoveOpening2D.en: Select the opening and move it in the wall plane with Rhino Move. Association synchronization handles the position change.

rsEditOpening2D.zh: 选中门窗或电梯，在属性面板中调整对应的建筑参数。
rsEditOpening2D.en: Select the door, window, or elevator and edit its building parameters in the Properties panel.

rsDeleteOpening2D.zh: 选中门窗后使用 Rhino 的 Delete，宿主墙体的开口会同步更新。
rsDeleteOpening2D.en: Select the opening and use Rhino Delete. The opening in its host wall updates accordingly.

RSToolActivateLicense.zh: 在 RSTool 客户端中登录并完成设备授权；2.0 不再使用旧的独立激活命令。
RSToolActivateLicense.en: Sign in and authorize the device in the RSTool client. Version 2.0 no longer uses the old standalone activation command.

rsAiRender.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个 Rhino 命令。客户端中的 AI 渲染页面不等于保留了旧命令入口。
rsAiRender.en: This Rhino command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. The client AI rendering page does not preserve the old command entry.

rsAiRenderOld.zh: 旧版 AI 渲染入口不再保留；请从客户端进入 AI 渲染，不要将 rsAiRender 当作已可用的替代命令。
rsAiRenderOld.en: The legacy AI-rendering entry is no longer exposed. Open AI rendering in the client; rsAiRender is not an available replacement command.

rsAIModeler.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个命令，旧版 AI 建模流程不能按本页直接调用。
rsAIModeler.en: This command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. The legacy AI-modeling workflow cannot be invoked from this page.

rsAIModelerLog.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个旧日志入口。
rsAIModelerLog.en: This legacy log command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source.

rsAiAnimation.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个 Rhino 动画命令；客户端视频生成功能与旧版相机动画流程不能直接等同。
rsAiAnimation.en: This Rhino animation command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Client video generation is not equivalent to the legacy camera-animation workflow.

rsModelingCompanion.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个命令，暂保留旧版参考。
rsModelingCompanion.en: This command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Its legacy reference is retained.

rsModelingCompanionSettings.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个设置入口，暂保留旧版参考。
rsModelingCompanionSettings.en: This settings command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Its legacy reference is retained.

rsConvertWallToNormalBrep.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个旧墙体转换命令，不能直接沿用旧版操作步骤。
rsConvertWallToNormalBrep.en: The old wall-conversion command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Do not reuse the legacy steps unchanged.

rsCopyOpening2D.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个命令，也不能把普通 Copy 当作已完整替代的开洞复制流程。
rsCopyOpening2D.en: This command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Ordinary Copy is not a verified complete replacement for copying hosted openings.

rsConvertA2DToNormalCurves.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个通用二维转换命令，暂保留旧版参考。
rsConvertA2DToNormalCurves.en: This general 2D conversion command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Its legacy reference is retained.

rsXLine.zh: 当前 2.0 未注册这个辅助长线命令，暂保留旧版参考。
rsXLine.en: This construction-line command is not registered in the reviewed 2.0 source. Its legacy reference is retained.

rsWall.zh: 统一墙体窗口可选择二维或三维；rsWall2D 以二维模式打开同一面板。
rsWall.en: The unified wall window supports 2D and 3D. rsWall2D opens the same panel initially in 2D.

rsWall2D.zh: 此快捷入口仍保留，以二维模式打开统一墙体面板，也可在面板中切换三维。
rsWall2D.en: This shortcut is retained. It opens the unified wall panel initially in 2D, and the panel also allows switching to 3D.

rsDoor.zh: 二维和三维门统一在此绘制；旧 rsDoor2D 名称不再是独立入口。
rsDoor.en: Create 2D and 3D doors here. The old rsDoor2D name is no longer a separate entry.

rsWindow.zh: 二维和三维窗统一在此绘制；旧 rsWindow2D 名称不再是独立入口。
rsWindow.en: Create 2D and 3D windows here. The old rsWindow2D name is no longer a separate entry.

rsElevator.zh: 二维和三维电梯统一在此绘制，原 rsElevator2D 不再独立调用。
rsElevator.en: Create 2D and 3D elevators here. rsElevator2D is no longer a standalone command.

rsCurtain.zh: 统一幕墙窗口支持二维和三维；rsCurtainWall2D 是二维快捷入口，rsCurtainPlus 仍独立保留。
rsCurtain.en: The unified curtain-wall window supports 2D and 3D. rsCurtainWall2D is a 2D shortcut; rsCurtainPlus remains separate.

rsCurtainWall2D.zh: 此快捷入口仍保留，以二维模式打开统一幕墙面板，也可在面板中切换三维。
rsCurtainWall2D.en: This shortcut is retained. It opens the unified curtain-wall panel initially in 2D, and the panel also allows switching to 3D.

rsDoubleFlightStairs.zh: 已合并原 rsStair2D，可在同一面板中绘制二维或三维双跑楼梯。
rsDoubleFlightStairs.en: Now includes the former rsStair2D workflow. Create 2D or 3D double-flight stairs in one panel.

rsMultiFlightStairs.zh: 已合并原 rsPolylineStair2D，共用路径，支持二维和三维多跑楼梯。
rsMultiFlightStairs.en: Now includes the former rsPolylineStair2D workflow, sharing a path for 2D and 3D multi-flight stairs.

rsSpiralStair.zh: 支持二维和三维参数楼梯，并可在属性面板中切换；基础线控制点不适用于旋转楼梯。
rsSpiralStair.en: Supports 2D and 3D parametric stairs with switching in Properties. Baseline control-point editing does not apply to spiral stairs.

rsModel.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsModel.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsMaterial.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsMaterial.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsEarth.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsEarth.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsImageStudio.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsImageStudio.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsVectorStudio.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsVectorStudio.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsPdfTools.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsPdfTools.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsProfileDirector.zh: Rhino 参数主面板保留；样式库、组件库和截面库合并到客户端的同一工具页。
rsProfileDirector.en: The Rhino parameter panel is retained. Style, component, and profile libraries share one client tool page.

rsMindMap.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsMindMap.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsWhiteboard.zh: 2.0 使用 RSTool 客户端承载面板，请先保持客户端运行并登录。
rsWhiteboard.en: Version 2.0 hosts this panel in the RSTool client. Keep the client running and signed in.

rsNurbsFacade.zh: 支持参数对象持续编辑，选中后在对应属性页修改；需要普通几何时使用页面中的专用转换或分解入口。
rsNurbsFacade.en: Supports persistent editing of parametric objects in their Properties page. Use the dedicated conversion or explode entry described on the page when ordinary geometry is needed.

rsMeshFacade.zh: 支持参数对象持续编辑，选中后在对应属性页修改；需要普通几何时使用页面中的专用转换或分解入口。
rsMeshFacade.en: Supports persistent editing of parametric objects in their Properties page. Use the dedicated conversion or explode entry described on the page when ordinary geometry is needed.

rsRailing.zh: 支持参数对象持续编辑，选中后在对应属性页修改；需要普通几何时使用页面中的专用转换或分解入口。
rsRailing.en: Supports persistent editing of parametric objects in their Properties page. Use the dedicated conversion or explode entry described on the page when ordinary geometry is needed.

rsPdfTool.zh: 与 rsPdfTools 打开同一个客户端 PDF 工具页面，两个名称都保留。
rsPdfTool.en: Opens the same client PDF Tools page as rsPdfTools. Both command names are retained.
